correctness.rationale: The projected zonotope has area sum_{i<j} a_i a_j |u_i v_j-u_j v_i|. Reconstructed E D_ij=1/(d-1) by conditional sphere/Beta integrals, E D_ij^2=2/[d(d-1)] via Cauchy-Binet, shared-index mixed moment 4/[pi d(d-1)] via planar SO(2), and disjoint moment 1/[d(d-1)] via the self-dual/anti-self-dual S²×S² decomposition of oriented Gr_2(R4). Checking the 3+3 pair classes recovers all coefficients 2,8/pi,6 of the exact second moment. Independent Gaussian-Stiefel sampling (40,000 frames each at d=3,4,5,7) reproduced first/second moments and the mixed Plücker correlations to Monte Carlo precision; these diagnostics do not prove general dimensions. d=3 and empty quadruple sums handled; cube var=(d-2)(4/pi-5/4). The higher-dimensional conditional Grassmannian factorization was justified by SO(4) transitivity and its SO(3)×SO(3) action, not by assuming six Plücker coordinates independent.
